description: This file defines the InterlockedFlag class used for thread-safe flag management within the Orleans testing framework, marked with serializers and identifiers for serialization.

classes.name: InterlockedFlag
classes.description: A thread-safe flag class that uses Interlocked operations to set and check a boolean-like state.

methods.name: InterlockedFlag
methods.description: Constructor initializing the flag to a reset state.

methods.name: IsSet
methods.description: Property indicating whether the flag is set.

methods.name: TrySet
methods.description: Attempts to set the flag atomically; returns true if successful.

methods.name: ThrowNotInitializedIfSet
methods.description: Throws InvalidOperationException if the flag is set, indicating improper access.

methods.name: ThrowDisposedIfSet
methods.description: Throws ObjectDisposedException if the flag is set, indicating the object has been disposed.
